content_sections.heading: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Maharaja Bhupinder Singh Punjab Sports University, Patiala, has issued for Teaching and Non-Teaching recruitment at the university and its constituent colleges.

content_sections.heading: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For Assistant Professor (Physical Education), candidates generally require a Master's degree with at least 55% marks or an equivalent grading-system qualification in the concerned or allied discipline from a recognized university. The notification refers to UGC Regulations, 2018, and subsequent applicable amendments. Applicants claiming Ph.D. exemption must meet the notified conditions rather than relying on possession of a Ph.D. degree alone. Applicants must have a recognized Ph.D., a Master's degree with at least 55% marks, a minimum of eight years of relevant teaching or research experience and at least seven publications in peer-reviewed or UGC-listed journals. A research score of at least 75 under the applicable UGC Academic/Research Score provisions is also required. Candidates must possess a graduate degree in any discipline along with the prescribed Sports Coaching qualification from a recognized institution such as SAI, NIS or another approved sports university or institute. The notice also requires relevant coaching experience and participation or achievement in recognized sporting competitions. Important: The candidate's sports specialization must match the discipline or game for which the trainer is being recruited. Candidates must possess a graduate degree from a recognized university with at least 55% marks and the prescribed Yoga qualification, including a relevant postgraduate Yoga diploma or recognized Yoga certification. The notification also requires a minimum of two years of practical experience in Yoga and the prescribed Matriculation-level Punjabi language qualification. Candidates must have passed 10+2 with Science from a recognized Board/University/Institute and possess a Bachelor's degree in Physiotherapy. Applicants must possess a B.E./B.Tech. degree in Information Technology, Electronics and Communication, Computer Science or another specifically accepted discipline, or the prescribed postgraduate qualification in Computer Applications. Candidates must possess a B.Com. degree from a recognized university or a degree with the applicable ICWA/CMA qualification, together with the prescribed relevant experience. Experience in accounts, audit, finance or Government/PSU/university accounts administration is required as specified for the post. Candidates must possess a recognized Bachelor's degree, relevant administrative or office supervisory experience and working computer knowledge. Storekeeper candidates need a recognized Bachelor's degree and the prescribed experience or computer qualification under the notified alternatives. Candidates need 10+2 from a recognized Board/University with an equivalent Science subject qualification and the prescribed diploma or degree in sports-related or laboratory fields, including Sports Science, Sports Technology, Sports Physiotherapy or Physical Education, as applicable. The university also refers to relevant laboratory experience, computer knowledge and Punjabi language requirements. U

content_sections.heading: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive pay according to the applicable 7th CPC Pay Matrix adopted by the Government of Punjab . Salary Clarification: These amounts represent the minimum basic pay in the notified pay matrix, not guaranteed take-home salary. Applicable allowances, deductions and service benefits will be governed by the relevant Punjab Government and university rules.

content_sections.heading: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee is Rs. 2,000 for General category candidates and Rs. 1,500 for eligible SC, ST, BC, EWS, Ex-Servicemen and Persons with Disabilities candidates . Both amounts include GST. Payment Mode: Online payment through the official recruitment portal. Last Date for Fee Payment: 4 December 2026. The fee is non-refundable. Candidates applying for different posts or the same designation at different campuses must submit separate applications and pay separate fees.

content_sections.heading: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process depends on whether the candidate is applying for a teaching, administrative, technical or Group-C post. Scrutiny of online applications and supporting documents. Verification of prescribed UGC/NCTE and university qualifications. Academic and research score assessment, where applicable. Shortlisting of eligible applicants. Interview or other assessment prescribed by the competent selection committee. Document verification and final selection according to university rules. The notification specifies a Punjabi language qualifying examination for Group-C recruitment. Application eligibility scrutiny. Punjabi language qualifying test. Written examination for candidates qualifying in Punjabi. Skill test, where applicable. Document verification. Final selection according to the notified criteria. Candidates applying for Group-C posts must pass a Punjabi language qualifying examination equivalent to Matriculation standard. Important: Candidates who fail to secure the minimum 50% in the Punjabi qualifying test will not be considered for the subsequent written examination and skill test under the prescribed Group-C selection process.

content_sections.heading: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply online through the university's recruitment facility between 9 November and 4 December 2026 . Official Careers Page: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Online Application Last Date: 4 December 2026. Hard-Copy Submission Last Date: 9 December 2026. The application process has two mandatory stages: online application with payment, followed by submission of four physical application sets.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for MBSPSU Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit www.mbspsu.ac.in . Open the Careers section. Find . Read the detailed recruitment notification and instructions carefully. Review the eligibility for the selected post and institution. Open the official recruitment application facility. Register using the required personal and contact details. Enter an active email address and mobile number. Select the correct post and campus. Complete the educational qualification and experience details. Enter category, domicile, sports achievements and other information as applicable. Upload the photograph, signature and prescribed documents. Review the application and ensure that all information matches the certificates. Pay the applicable application fee online. Complete final submission by 4 December 2026 . Download and print the submitted application form. Prepare four sets of the printed application as prescribed. Attach self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials to one complete set. Submit all four sets to the Registrar by 9 December 2026 . Keep a copy of the application and proof of delivery for future reference.

content_sections.heading: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Hard-Copy Submission Rules
content_sections.text: The university requires candidates to submit four printed sets of the online application form . Accepted Submission Methods: Courier, Registered Post or in person. content_sections.heading: Documents Required for MBSPSU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applicants must upload the documents specified by the recruitment portal and attach self-attested copies of the relevant supporting certificates to the first hard-copy set. Completed online application form printout. Proof of date of birth. Matriculation certificate and Punjabi language qualification proof. Higher Secondary, graduation and postgraduate qualification certificates, as applicable. Ph.D. degree certificate and applicable UGC/NET/SLET/SET records for teaching posts. Research publications, academic score and experience documents, where required. Sports coaching diploma, participation certificate or training records, where applicable. Professional qualification and registration certificates, where applicable. Employment and experience certificates for posts requiring experience. Punjab domicile certificate, where claiming applicable reservation benefits. SC/ST/BC/EWS/PwD/Ex-Servicemen certificates, where applicable. Recent passport-size photograph. Scanned signature. Photo identity proof. Online fee payment receipt. Employer endorsement or NOC, where applicable. Other documents prescribed in the university's application instructions. Important: The notification includes declaration and employer endorsement formats. Candidates employed in Government, autonomous or other organizations must follow the applicable employer endorsement procedure.

content_sections.heading: MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Reservation and Punjab Domicile Rules
content_sections.text: Reservation is governed by the Government of Punjab's applicable policy, as amended from time to time. Candidates seeking reservation must ensure that the relevant certificate has been issued by the competent authority and is valid under the applicable Punjab Government rules.

content_sections.heading: Are MBSPSU Recruitment 2026 Posts Permanent?
content_sections.text: The advertised vacancy count is indicative and may be revised. MBSPSU may increase, decrease or decide not to fill certain posts according to its recruitment requirements.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in MBSPSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official careers website lists 123 Teaching and Non-Teaching vacancies under Advertisement No. 04/2026. The individual vacancy rows also add up to 123, although the PDF incorrectly prints 28 instead of 29 as the Jalandhar subtotal.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online for MBSPSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application and fee payment is 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. When do MBSPSU online applications start?
faq.answer: Online applications start on 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the hard copy?
faq.answer: The four printed application sets must reach the Registrar by 9 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is hard-copy submission mandatory?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must submit four printed application sets, including one complete set with self-attested supporting documents.

faq.question: Q6. What posts are available in MBSPSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, Lecturer, Sports Trainer, Yoga Trainer, Dietician, Physiotherapist, Librarian, Technical Assistant, Accounts Assistant, Office Superintendent, Storekeeper, Lab Attendant and Clerk.

faq.question: Q7. What is the educational qualification for MBSPSU Recruitment?
faq.answer: Qualifications vary according to the post and include 10+2, Diploma, Graduation, Postgraduation, professional coaching qualifications, NET/SLET/SET and Ph.D., as applicable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the qualification for MBSPSU Assistant Professor?
faq.answer: Assistant Professor (Physical Education) generally requires a relevant Master's degree with at least 55% marks and NET/SLET/SET or a qualifying Ph.D. exemption under UGC rules.

faq.question: Q9. Can 12th-pass candidates apply?
faq.answer: Certain support positions include 10+2 as part of the educational qualification, but additional relevant diploma, degree or professional requirements may apply. Candidates should check the exact post-specific eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the age limit for MBSPSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The general upper age limit for teaching posts is 45 years, while the ordinary age limit for non-teaching posts is 18 to 37 years, subject to applicable rules and relaxation.
